rule_text: Every mandatory document for the vendor's constitution and category is received.
A vendor that declares MSME status has sent a Udyam registration certificate.
if_not_met: Chase for the certificate or a written confirmation that the vendor is not an MSME

rule_text: Every document can be read in full: names, numbers and dates.
if_not_met: Chase for a clear copy of the document

rule_text: The GSTIN on the GST certificate has 15 characters and a valid check character.
if_not_met: Chase for the certificate downloaded from the GST portal

rule_text: The PAN has the standard structure and its fourth character matches the constitution.
if_not_met: Chase for the PAN of the vendor entity

rule_text: The IFSC on the bank proof has the standard structure.
if_not_met: Chase for a cheque or bank letter with the right IFSC

rule_text: The GSTIN state code matches the principal place of business on the certificate and the state the vendor declared.
if_not_met: Chase for the GST certificate of the state the vendor supplies from

rule_text: The bank proof is a cheque leaf with the account holder's name printed, or a bank letter signed and stamped by the bank.
if_not_met: Chase for an acceptable bank proof

rule_text: Declarations are on the vendor's letterhead, signed, and for the current financial year where they are annual.
applies_to: Transport vendors; vendors not registered under GST
if_not_met: Chase for a signed, current declaration

rule_text: No document with an expiry date has lapsed on the verification date.
if_not_met: Chase for the renewed document unless EXP-03 applies

rule_text: A document that lapses within 30 days of verification is flagged and its renewal is requested.
if_not_met: Not a blocker. Ask for the renewed document or renewal receipt and flag the record for approval

rule_text: A lapsed document is accepted with a renewal receipt only if the renewal was filed on or before the expiry date, the receipt is less than 60 days old, and it names the same licence and legal entity. Needs human sign-off.
applies_to: A lapsed document sent with a renewal receipt
evidence: The lapsed document and the receipt
if_not_met: If all conditions hold, accept with human sign-off; otherwise treat as EXP-01

rule_text: The legal name is identical across the GST certificate, PAN, incorporation document and Udyam certificate, and licences carry the legal or trade name.
evidence: GST, PAN, incorporation document, Udyam, licences
if_not_met: Chase for a document in the legal name, or the fresh certificate after a change of name

rule_text: The PAN inside the GSTIN (characters 3 to 12) equals the PAN on the PAN document and on the EPF certificate.
evidence: GST certificate, PAN document, EPF certificate
if_not_met: Chase for the PAN of the entity that holds the GSTIN

rule_text: The account holder on the bank proof equals the legal name (for a proprietorship, the proprietor's name or the trade name).
if_not_met: Chase for bank proof of an account in the legal name

rule_text: No existing vendor on the master has the same PAN, GSTIN or bank account.
applies_to: Every request, before anything is created
if_not_met: Stop. Route to a human as a probable duplicate with the matching vendor number

rule_text: A vendor whose PAN is already on the master with a GSTIN of another state is an extension of the existing vendor.
if_not_met: Hand over as an extension of the existing vendor with the new GSTIN and address, for human approval

rule_text: Working days are Monday to Friday excluding group holidays: 15 Aug 2026 Independence Day; 28 Aug 2026 Raksha Bandhan; 04 Sep 2026 Janmashtami; 02 Oct 2026 Gandhi Jayanti; 20 Oct 2026 Dussehra; 09 Nov 2026 Diwali; 10 Nov 2026 Gujarati New Year; 11 Nov 2026 Bhai Bij.

When a document set is verified and anything is open, send chase round 1 naming every open item. If nothing at all has arrived, chase round 1 is due 2 working days after the document checklist was sent.

Send chase round 2 naming what is still open when a reply to round 1 leaves anything open, or when 3 working days pass after round 1 with no reply, whichever comes first. New problems found in a reply are added to round 2.

After two unresolved rounds, stop chasing and escalate to the buyer who raised the request and the procurement lead for the company code, listing what is still open. Two unresolved rounds means a reply to round 2 still leaves items open, or 3 working days pass after round 2 with no reply.
An automatic out-of-office reply is not a reply. A reply that only asks a question or promises documents does not close any item. Reply to the question in the same thread.

A verified pack lists every document with its file, every rule with its result, and the values the master data team will key in: legal name, trade name, constitution, PAN, GSTIN, address, bank account, IFSC, account holder, MSME status and Udyam number.

A human approves any vendor that still carries an unresolved exception (including a renewal accepted under EXP-03 or a document expiring within 30 days), every probable duplicate, and every extension of an existing vendor.
